package.name: turn_on_wheeltec_robot
package.description: ROS2 (Humble) port of the turn_on_wheeltec_robot driver node. Bridges the wheeltec robot base's STM32 lower computer (serial, BCC-checked frame protocol) to ROS2 topics: /cmd_vel in, /odom, /imu, /PowerVoltage out. Ported from the original ROS1 (catkin) wheeltec_robot_node.
